protocol.purpose: Paired original-source and module-free candidate route, power and sustained output measurements with exact blueprint hashes.
protocol.supply: Both lanes of each exterior yellow belt carry only the labeled material. Source belts sit under the original filtered external pickup; candidates receive the same material directly at their new boundary inlet.
protocol.collection: Drain each original or candidate product chest every tick; no robot supply or internal injection. Sources retain their original interior chest locations.
protocol.modules: Install exactly the original source module requests in source cases; candidate cases have zero modules.
protocol.recipeAvailability: Enable exactly the saved recipe names; grant no other research effects.
protocol.electricity: Unlimited external source connected to one retained pole. Original external feeder arms may also need the exterior pole coverage; no fixture is placed inside a blueprint.
protocol.laneSampling: Every 60 ticks, inspect both native transport lines of each saved belt; reject any material outside its static lane proof. Include empty lane claims.
